row.title: Social loop needs 6-8 subrequests per run
row.body: The social loop's 5-call share (LOOP_MAX_COST.social) starved every post after 2026-11-20 01:10 UTC: gate, calendar, tenant queue, a DPoP token refresh and a post need 6 to 8 calls. Share is now 9 (minimum 6). A channel with no token is not a channel. Tenants publish a queue (social/gate.json tenant_queues) and core only drains it.

title: Social loop needs 6-8 subrequests per run
